description: JavaScript module defining the SMSManager class for handling SMS notifications within the ERPNext system, including message setup, contact retrieval, and dialog UI interactions.

classes.name: SMSManager
classes.description: Class for managing SMS notifications, including message setup, contact retrieval, and sending SMS via dialog interface.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default messages based on document type and triggers display.

methods.name: get_contact_number
methods.description: Fetches contact number via an API call based on contact name and reference details.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the SMS dialog with message and contact number, fetching contact if necessary.

methods.name: show_dialog
methods.description: Creates and displays the SMS sending dialog.

methods.name: make_dialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog UI for sending SMS, including event handling for the send button.
